# lzt/ui

> Atomic XenForo 2.x and Lolzteam UI components and CLI for React, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.

lzt/ui is an open-source, shadcn-like component distribution system for building Lolzteam / XenForo-styled user interfaces. Instead of a monolithic runtime library, source code for atomic TypeScript components is copied directly into the consuming project (`src/components/ui/`).

- Live documentation & interactive showcase: https://lzt-ui.vercel.app
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/lonestill/lzt-ui
- NPM Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@scopelzt/lzt-ui
- Full Documentation & Code Context: https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## CLI Installation & Usage

- Init project (injects tokens into CSS, creates `src/lib/utils.ts`, creates `components.json`):
  `npx @scopelzt/lzt-ui init`
- Add single or multiple components:
  `npx @scopelzt/lzt-ui add button dialog table`
- Add all 15 components:
  `npx @scopelzt/lzt-ui add --all`
- List available components:
  `npx @scopelzt/lzt-ui list`

## Core Design Tokens & Colors

- Page background: `rgb(12, 15, 14)` (`--lzt-bg-page`)
- Section background: `rgb(17, 22, 21)` (`--lzt-bg-section`)
- Component background: `rgb(30, 39, 37)` (`--lzt-bg-component`)
- Sub-element background: `rgb(24, 30, 28)` (`--lzt-bg-sub`)
- Hover background: `rgb(36, 47, 43)` (`--lzt-bg-hover`)
- Primary border: `rgb(36, 47, 43)` (`--lzt-border`)
- Subtle border: `rgb(30, 39, 37)` (`--lzt-border-subtle`)
- Accent green: `#00ba78` / `rgb(34, 142, 93)` (`--lzt-green-accent`)
- Primary button gradient: `linear-gradient(88deg, rgb(32, 118, 78) 0%, rgb(42, 143, 92) 50%, rgb(32, 118, 78) 100%)`
- Primary text: `rgb(245, 245, 245)` (`--lzt-text-primary`)
- Body text: `rgb(214, 214, 214)` (`--lzt-text-body`)
- Muted text: `rgb(140, 162, 154)` (`--lzt-text-muted`)
- Dim text: `rgb(90, 105, 99)` (`--lzt-text-dim`)

## Components Reference

- [Button](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/button): XenForo buttons (`.button`). Variants: `primary` (green gradient), `secondary` (dark outline), `default`, `danger`, `ghost`, `more`. Props: `variant`, `size` (`default` 34px, `sm` 28px, `lg` 38px, `icon`), `isLoading`, `asChild`.
- [Table](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/table): Data table (`.dataTable`). Includes `Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell`. Authentic row hover, zebra striping, market row formatting.
- [Dialog](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/dialog): Modal dialogs (`.xenOverlay`, `.formOverlay`). Includes `Dialog`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogContent`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogBody`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogClose`. Default 20px padding via `DialogBody`.
- [Toast](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/toast): Stack notification queue (`#StackAlerts`) fixed to bottom-left, plus `timedMessage` popups. Exports `ToastProvider`, `useToast` (`toast`, `stackAlert`, `timedMessage`).
- [Alert](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/alert): Banner alerts (`.importantMessage`) and error modals (`AlertModal`). Variants: `warning` (amber), `error` (dark red), `success` (green), `default`.
- [Badge](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/badge): User banners (`variant="banner"`) and tags (`variant="tag"`). Groups: `admin`, `developer`, `curator`, `resident`, `expert`, `guru`, `ai`, `greatest`, `legend`, etc.
- [UniqText](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/uniq): Forum nickname animations with neon shadows, glow, and gradients. Presets: `extasy`, `scope`, `raysmorgan`, `flame`, `gold`, `greatest`, `zelenka`, `uniq`. Props: `preset`, `glow`.
- [DropdownMenu](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/dropdown-menu): Contextual dropdowns and XenForo visitor menu. Includes `DropdownMenu`, `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownMenuContent`, `DropdownMenuItem`, `DottesTrigger`, `AccountTrigger`, `AccountMenu`.
- [Input](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/input): Text fields (`.textCtrl`). Includes `Input` (default 34px, extraLarge 38px), `Textarea`, `InputRelative`, `InputRelativeIcon`.
- [Select](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/select): Custom Chosen-style select dropdown. Props: `options`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `searchable`, `size` (default 34px, extraLarge 38px).
- [Checkbox](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/checkbox): XenForo custom checkboxes and radio buttons. Includes `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `CheckboxItem`, `CheckboxRow`.
- [Tabs](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tabs): Forum tabs (`.tabs`) with animated sliding green indicator line. Includes `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`. Variants: `forum`, `subTabs`, `pill`.
- [Pagination](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/pagination): Page navigation bar (`.pageNav`). Props: `currentPage`, `totalPages`, `onPageChange`, `siblingCount`, `showTitle`.
- [Tooltip](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tooltip): Dark tooltips with pointer arrow. Props: `content`, `placement` (`top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`), `variant` (`default`, `dark`, `darkGreen`, `statusTip`), `delay`.
- [Avatar](https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/avatar): User avatar with online indicator dot and group ring outline. Props: `src`, `fallback`, `size` (`mention`, `sm` 32px, `default` 32px, `lg` 66px, `xl` 96px), `isOnline`, `status`.

## Optional / Full Documentation

- Full Design Tokens & CSS Variables: https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs/brand
- Component Documentation Index: https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/docs
- Full LLM Context: https://lzt-ui.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Helper Utilities (templates/utils.ts)

```typescript
import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx";
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}
```

## Component Source Code

### pagination.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface PaginationProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  currentPage: number;
  totalPages: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  siblingCount?: number;
  showTitle?: boolean;
}

export function Pagination({
  currentPage,
  totalPages,
  onPageChange,
  siblingCount = 1,
  showTitle = true,
  className,
  ...props
}: PaginationProps) {
  const pages = React.useMemo(() => {
    const totalPageNumbers = siblingCount * 2 + 5;

    if (totalPages <= totalPageNumbers) {
      return Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1);
    }

    const leftSiblingIndex = Math.max(currentPage - siblingCount, 1);
    const rightSiblingIndex = Math.min(currentPage + siblingCount, totalPages);

    const shouldShowLeftDots = leftSiblingIndex > 2;
    const shouldShowRightDots = rightSiblingIndex < totalPages - 1;

    if (!shouldShowLeftDots && shouldShowRightDots) {
      const leftItemCount = 3 + 2 * siblingCount;
      const leftRange = Array.from({ length: leftItemCount }, (_, i) => i + 1);
      return [...leftRange, "...", totalPages];
    }

    if (shouldShowLeftDots && !shouldShowRightDots) {
      const rightItemCount = 3 + 2 * siblingCount;
      const rightRange = Array.from(
        { length: rightItemCount },
        (_, i) => totalPages - rightItemCount + i + 1
      );
      return [1, "...", ...rightRange];
    }

    const middleRange = Array.from(
      { length: rightSiblingIndex - leftSiblingIndex + 1 },
      (_, i) => leftSiblingIndex + i
    );
    return [1, "...", ...middleRange, "...", totalPages];
  }, [totalPages, siblingCount, currentPage]);

  if (totalPages <= 1) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "PageNav flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5 select-none",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {showTitle && (
        <span className="pageNavHeader text-[13px] text-[rgb(140,162,154)] pr-2 leading-[30px]">
          Страница {currentPage} из {totalPages}
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Prev button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={currentPage <= 1}
        onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage - 1)}
        className={cn(
          "PageNavPrev flex h-[30px] w-[30px] items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-transparent text-[13px] font-semibold text-[rgb(214,214,214)] transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer hover:bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:text-white",
          currentPage <= 1 && "pointer-events-none opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-transparent"
        )}
        title="Предыдущая"
        aria-label="Предыдущая страница"
      >
        <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
      </button>

      {/* Page Numbers */}
      {pages.map((page, index) => {
        if (page === "...") {
          return (
            <span
              key={`dots-${index}`}
              className="flex h-[30px] w-[30px] items-center justify-center text-[13px] text-[rgb(140,162,154)]"
            >
              ...
            </span>
          );
        }

        const pageNumber = Number(page);
        const isCurrent = pageNumber === currentPage;

        return (
          <button
            key={pageNumber}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onPageChange(pageNumber)}
            className={cn(
              "flex h-[30px] min-w-[30px] px-2 items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-transparent text-[13px] font-semibold transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer",
              isCurrent
                ? "currentPage bg-[rgb(34,142,93)] text-[rgb(245,245,245)] font-bold shadow-sm"
                : "text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:text-white"
            )}
            aria-current={isCurrent ? "page" : undefined}
          >
            {pageNumber}
          </button>
        );
      })}

      {/* Next button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
        onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage + 1)}
        className={cn(
          "PageNavNext flex h-[30px] w-[30px] items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-transparent text-[13px] font-semibold text-[rgb(214,214,214)] transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer hover:bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:text-white",
          currentPage >= totalPages &&
            "pointer-events-none opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-transparent"
        )}
        title="Следующая"
        aria-label="Следующая страница"
      >
        <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### tabs.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type TabsVariant = "forum" | "subTabs" | "pill";

interface TabsContextType {
  value: string;
  onValueChange: (val: string) => void;
  variant: TabsVariant;
}

const TabsContext = React.createContext<TabsContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export interface TabsProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  variant?: TabsVariant;
}

export function Tabs({
  value: controlledValue,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  variant = "forum",
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: TabsProps) {
  const [uncontrolledValue, setUncontrolledValue] = React.useState(defaultValue || "");
  const isControlled = controlledValue !== undefined;
  const value = isControlled ? controlledValue : uncontrolledValue;

  const handleValueChange = React.useCallback(
    (newVal: string) => {
      if (!isControlled) {
        setUncontrolledValue(newVal);
      }
      onValueChange?.(newVal);
    },
    [isControlled, onValueChange]
  );

  return (
    <TabsContext.Provider value={{ value, onValueChange: handleValueChange, variant }}>
      <div className={cn("w-full", className)} {...props}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </TabsContext.Provider>
  );
}

export interface TabsListProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLUListElement> {
  variant?: TabsVariant;
}

export function TabsList({ className, variant: listVariant, children, ...props }: TabsListProps) {
  const context = React.useContext(TabsContext);
  const activeVariant = listVariant || context?.variant || "forum";

  if (activeVariant === "pill") {
    return (
      <ul
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 p-1 rounded-[10px] bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] border border-[rgb(30,39,37)] list-none select-none",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </ul>
    );
  }

  if (activeVariant === "subTabs") {
    return (
      <ul
        className={cn(
          "tabs subTabs flex items-center w-full bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] border-b border-[rgb(30,39,37)] px-2.5 m-0 list-none overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar select-none",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </ul>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ul
      className={cn(
        "tabs flex items-center w-full bg-[rgb(17,22,21)] border-b border-[rgb(30,39,37)] px-2.5 m-0 list-none overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar select-none",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </ul>
  );
}

export interface TabsTriggerProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  value: string;
  badge?: React.ReactNode;
  variant?: TabsVariant;
}

export function TabsTrigger({
  value,
  badge,
  variant: triggerVariant,
  className,
  children,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: TabsTriggerProps) {
  const context = React.useContext(TabsContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("TabsTrigger must be used inside Tabs");

  const isActive = context.value === value;
  const activeVariant = triggerVariant || context.variant || "forum";

  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    context.onValueChange(value);
    onClick?.(e);
  };

  if (activeVariant === "pill") {
    return (
      <li className="list-none">
        <button
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={isActive}
          onClick={handleClick}
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-[8px] text-xs font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer",
            isActive
              ? "bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] text-white shadow-sm"
              : "text-[rgb(140,162,154)] hover:text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:bg-[rgb(30,39,37)]/50",
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
          {badge !== undefined && (
            <span
              className={cn(
                "rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tabular-nums",
                isActive
                  ? "bg-[#00ba78]/20 text-[#00ba78]"
                  : "bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] text-[rgb(140,162,154)]"
              )}
            >
              {badge}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>
      </li>
    );
  }

  return (
    <li className={cn("list-none mx-1 font-semibold", isActive && "active")}>
      <button
        type="button"
        role="tab"
        aria-selected={isActive}
        onClick={handleClick}
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center gap-2 h-[46px] px-3.5 text-sm font-semibold transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer bg-transparent border-0 outline-none whitespace-nowrap",
          activeVariant === "subTabs" && "h-[36px] text-xs px-2.5",
          isActive
            ? "text-[#00ba78] shadow-[inset_0_-2px_0_0_#00ba78]"
            : "text-[rgb(140,162,154)] hover:text-[rgb(245,245,245)] hover:shadow-[inset_0_-2px_0_0_rgb(30,39,37)]",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span>{children}</span>
        {badge !== undefined && (
          <span
            className={cn(
              "rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums leading-none",
              isActive
                ? "bg-[#00ba78]/20 text-[#00ba78]"
                : "bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] text-[rgb(140,162,154)]"
            )}
          >
            {badge}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>
    </li>
  );
}

export interface TabsContentProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  value: string;
}

export function TabsContent({ value, className, children, ...props }: TabsContentProps) {
  const context = React.useContext(TabsContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("TabsContent must be used inside Tabs");

  if (context.value !== value) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="tabpanel"
      className={cn("pt-4 animate-in fade-in-0 duration-150", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### tooltip.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface TooltipProps {
  content: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactElement<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>>;
  placement?: "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right";
  variant?: "default" | "dark" | "darkGreen" | "statusTip";
  delay?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export function Tooltip({
  content,
  children,
  placement = "top",
  variant = "dark",
  delay = 120,
  className,
}: TooltipProps) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = React.useState(false);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = React.useState(false);
  const [coords, setCoords] = React.useState<{ top: number; left: number; transform: string } | null>(null);
  const triggerRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const timeoutRef = React.useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    return () => {
      if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const updatePosition = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!triggerRef.current) return;
    const rect = triggerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

    switch (placement) {
      case "top":
        setCoords({
          top: rect.top - 8,
          left: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
          transform: "translate(-50%, -100%)",
        });
        break;
      case "bottom":
        setCoords({
          top: rect.bottom + 8,
          left: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
          transform: "translate(-50%, 0)",
        });
        break;
      case "left":
        setCoords({
          top: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
          left: rect.left - 8,
          transform: "translate(-100%, -50%)",
        });
        break;
      case "right":
        setCoords({
          top: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
          left: rect.right + 8,
          transform: "translate(0, -50%)",
        });
        break;
    }
  }, [placement]);

  const show = () => {
    updatePosition();
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      updatePosition();
      setVisible(true);
    }, delay);
  };

  const hide = () => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    }
    setVisible(false);
  };

  const variantStyles = {
    default: "bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] border-[rgb(69,69,70)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)]",
    dark: "bg-[rgb(17,22,21)] border-[rgb(36,47,43)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] shadow-xl",
    darkGreen: "bg-[rgb(18,76,50)] border-[rgb(34,142,93)] text-[rgb(245,245,245)]",
    statusTip: "statusTip bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] border-[rgb(69,69,70)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] w-[250px] whitespace-normal leading-[17px] p-[5px_10px]",
  };

  const arrowStyles = {
    top: "bottom-[-5px] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-t-[5px] border-x-[5px] border-b-0 border-x-transparent",
    bottom: "top-[-5px] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-b-[5px] border-x-[5px] border-t-0 border-x-transparent",
    left: "right-[-5px] top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-l-[5px] border-y-[5px] border-r-0 border-y-transparent",
    right: "left-[-5px] top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-r-[5px] border-y-[5px] border-l-0 border-y-transparent",
  };

  const arrowColorStyles = {
    default: {
      top: "border-t-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
      bottom: "border-b-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
      left: "border-l-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
      right: "border-r-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
    },
    dark: {
      top: "border-t-[rgb(17,22,21)]",
      bottom: "border-b-[rgb(17,22,21)]",
      left: "border-l-[rgb(17,22,21)]",
      right: "border-r-[rgb(17,22,21)]",
    },
    darkGreen: {
      top: "border-t-[rgb(18,76,50)]",
      bottom: "border-b-[rgb(18,76,50)]",
      left: "border-l-[rgb(18,76,50)]",
      right: "border-r-[rgb(18,76,50)]",
    },
    statusTip: {
      top: "border-t-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
      bottom: "border-b-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
      left: "border-l-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
      right: "border-r-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
    },
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={triggerRef}
      className="relative inline-flex items-center"
      onMouseEnter={show}
      onMouseLeave={hide}
      onFocus={show}
      onBlur={hide}
    >
      {children}

      {visible && mounted && content && coords && createPortal(
        <div
          role="tooltip"
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            top: coords.top,
            left: coords.left,
            transform: coords.transform,
          }}
          className={cn(
            "xenTooltip pointer-events-none z-[15000] whitespace-nowrap rounded-[8px] border px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-normal leading-tight transition-opacity duration-150 animate-in fade-in-0",
            variantStyles[variant],
            className
          )}
        >
          {content}
          <div
            className={cn(
              "arrow absolute h-0 w-0 border-solid",
              arrowStyles[placement],
              arrowColorStyles[variant][placement]
            )}
          />
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### alert.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type AlertVariant = "error" | "destructive" | "warning" | "success" | "default";

export interface AlertProps
  extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title"> {
  variant?: AlertVariant;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
  onClose?: () => void;
  isModal?: boolean;
  open?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  shake?: boolean;
}

const HEADER_STYLES: Record<
  AlertVariant,
  { bg: string; defaultTitle: string }
> = {
  error: {
    bg: "bg-[linear-gradient(140deg,rgb(142,34,34)_0%,rgb(85,20,20)_100%)]",
    defaultTitle: "Произошла ошибка:",
  },
  destructive: {
    bg: "bg-[linear-gradient(140deg,rgb(142,34,34)_0%,rgb(85,20,20)_100%)]",
    defaultTitle: "Произошла ошибка:",
  },
  warning: {
    bg: "bg-[linear-gradient(140deg,rgb(184,115,18)_0%,rgb(110,68,11)_100%)]",
    defaultTitle: "Внимание:",
  },
  success: {
    bg: "bg-[linear-gradient(140deg,rgb(32,118,78)_0%,rgb(20,74,49)_100%)]",
    defaultTitle: "Успешно:",
  },
  default: {
    bg: "bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] border-b border-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
    defaultTitle: "Информация:",
  },
};

const Alert = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AlertProps>(
  (
    {
      className,
      variant = "error",
      title,
      onClose,
      isModal = false,
      open = true,
      onOpenChange,
      shake,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const [mounted, setMounted] = React.useState(false);
    const [rendered, setRendered] = React.useState(open);
    const [isClosing, setIsClosing] = React.useState(false);

    React.useEffect(() => {
      setMounted(true);
    }, []);

    // Smooth exit animation before unmounting
    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (open) {
        setRendered(true);
        setIsClosing(false);
      } else if (rendered) {
        setIsClosing(true);
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          setRendered(false);
          setIsClosing(false);
        }, 160);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    }, [open, rendered]);

    const handleClose = React.useCallback(() => {
      onClose?.();
      onOpenChange?.(false);
    }, [onClose, onOpenChange]);

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!isModal || !rendered) return;

      const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") {
          handleClose();
        }
      };

      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
      window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);

      return () => {
        document.body.style.overflow = "";
        window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
      };
    }, [isModal, rendered, handleClose]);

    if (!rendered) return null;

    const config = HEADER_STYLES[variant] || HEADER_STYLES.error;
    const resolvedTitle = title !== undefined ? title : config.defaultTitle;
    const showCloseButton = Boolean(onClose || onOpenChange || isModal);
    const shouldShake = shake !== undefined ? shake : (variant === "error" || variant === "destructive");

    const alertContent = (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="alert"
        className={cn(
          "errorOverlay relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[12px] border border-[rgb(30,39,37)] bg-[rgb(17,22,21)] shadow-2xl text-[rgb(214,214,214)] select-none",
          isModal && "max-w-[560px] z-50",
          isModal && (isClosing ? "anim-lzt-modal-out" : "anim-lzt-modal-in"),
          isModal && shouldShake && !isClosing && "anim-lzt-error-shake",
          className
        )}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        {...props}
      >
        {resolvedTitle && (
          <div
            className={cn(
              "heading flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-[15px] font-semibold text-sm text-[rgb(245,245,245)] leading-tight",
              config.bg,
              showCloseButton && "pr-14"
            )}
          >
            <span className="font-semibold text-[14px]">{resolvedTitle}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {showCloseButton && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleClose}
            aria-label="Закрыть"
            className="close OverlayCloser absolute right-3.5 top-3.5 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-white/[0.09] shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(233,233,233,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(233,233,233,0.5)] backdrop-blur-[2px] text-[#e9e9e9] opacity-80 hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[rgb(214,214,214)]" />
          </button>
        )}

        <div className="errorDetails p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-[rgb(214,214,214)]">
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    );

    if (isModal) {
      if (!mounted) return null;
      return createPortal(
        <div
          className={cn(
            "xenOverlay fixed inset-0 z-[10000] flex items-start justify-center pt-24 sm:pt-32 p-4 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-[2px]",
            isClosing ? "anim-lzt-backdrop-out" : "anim-lzt-backdrop-in"
          )}
          onClick={handleClose}
        >
          {alertContent}
        </div>,
        document.body
      );
    }

    return alertContent;
  }
);
Alert.displayName = "Alert";

export interface AlertModalProps extends Omit<AlertProps, "isModal"> {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function AlertModal({ open, onClose, ...props }: AlertModalProps) {
  return <Alert isModal open={open} onClose={onClose} {...props} />;
}

const AlertTitle = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <h5
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("font-semibold text-[14px] text-[rgb(245,245,245)]", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
AlertTitle.displayName = "AlertTitle";

const AlertDescription = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <div
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("text-[rgb(214,214,214)] text-sm leading-relaxed", className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
AlertDescription.displayName = "AlertDescription";

export { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription };

/**
 * Плашка важного сообщения (.importantMessage)
 */
export interface ImportantMessageProps
  extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  variant?: "default" | "warning" | "error" | "success";
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function ImportantMessage({
  variant = "default",
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: ImportantMessageProps) {
  const borderStyles = {
    default: "border-[rgb(36,47,43)] border-l-[rgb(34,142,93)]",
    warning: "border-[rgb(36,47,43)] border-l-[#e68c17]",
    error: "border-[rgb(36,47,43)] border-l-[#f13838]",
    success: "border-[rgb(36,47,43)] border-l-[#00ba78]",
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="note"
      className={cn(
        "importantMessage blockMessage my-2.5 rounded-[8px] border bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] px-4 py-3 text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-[rgb(214,214,214)] border-l-[3px]",
        borderStyles[variant],
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### avatar.tsx

```typescript
import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type AvatarSize = "mention" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "sm" | "default" | "lg" | "xl";

export interface AvatarProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  src?: string;
  fallback?: string;
  size?: AvatarSize;
  isOnline?: boolean;
  status?: "online" | "offline";
  userBadge?: React.ReactNode;
}

const sizeClasses: Record<string, { holder: string; img: string; text: string }> = {
  mention: {
    holder: "w-4 h-4 min-w-4",
    img: "w-4 h-4",
    text: "text-[9px]",
  },
  s: {
    holder: "w-8 h-8 min-w-8",
    img: "w-8 h-8",
    text: "text-xs",
  },
  sm: {
    holder: "w-8 h-8 min-w-8",
    img: "w-8 h-8",
    text: "text-xs",
  },
  default: {
    holder: "w-8 h-8 min-w-8",
    img: "w-8 h-8",
    text: "text-xs",
  },
  m: {
    holder: "w-[66px] h-[66px] min-w-[66px]",
    img: "w-[66px] h-[66px]",
    text: "text-base font-semibold",
  },
  lg: {
    holder: "w-[66px] h-[66px] min-w-[66px]",
    img: "w-[66px] h-[66px]",
    text: "text-base font-semibold",
  },
  l: {
    holder: "w-[96px] h-[96px] min-w-[96px]",
    img: "w-[96px] h-[96px]",
    text: "text-xl font-bold",
  },
  xl: {
    holder: "w-[96px] h-[96px] min-w-[96px]",
    img: "w-[96px] h-[96px]",
    text: "text-xl font-bold",
  },
};

export function Avatar({
  src,
  fallback = "U",
  size = "s",
  isOnline = false,
  status,
  userBadge,
  className,
  ...props
}: AvatarProps) {
  const currentSize = sizeClasses[size] || sizeClasses.s;
  const online = isOnline || status === "online";
  const initials = fallback.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() || "U";

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "avatarHolder relative inline-block select-none align-middle",
        currentSize.holder,
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <span className={cn("avatar block overflow-hidden rounded-full", currentSize.holder)}>
        {src ? (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img
            src={src}
            alt={fallback}
            className={cn(
              "img object-cover rounded-full",
              currentSize.img,
              "[image-rendering:-webkit-optimize-contrast]"
            )}
          />
        ) : (
          <span
            className={cn(
              "img flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] font-medium",
              currentSize.img,
              currentSize.text
            )}
          >
            {initials}
          </span>
        )}
      </span>

      {/* Online indicator */}
      {online && (
        <span
          className={cn(
            "absolute rounded-full bg-[#00ba78] ring-2 ring-[rgb(17,22,21)]",
            (size === "l" || size === "xl") ? "w-3.5 h-3.5 bottom-1 right-1" : "w-2.5 h-2.5 bottom-0 right-0"
          )}
          title="В сети"
        />
      )}

      {userBadge && (
        <div className="avatarUserBadge absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 z-10 flex items-center justify-center">
          {userBadge}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### dialog.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface DialogContextType {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
}

const DialogContext = React.createContext<DialogContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function Dialog({
  open: controlledOpen,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  children,
}: {
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [uncontrolledOpen, setUncontrolledOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
  const isControlled = controlledOpen !== undefined;
  const open = isControlled ? controlledOpen : uncontrolledOpen;

  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (action: React.SetStateAction<boolean>) => {
      const next = typeof action === "function" ? action(open) : action;
      if (!isControlled) {
        setUncontrolledOpen(next);
      }
      onOpenChange?.(next);
    },
    [isControlled, open, onOpenChange]
  );

  return (
    <DialogContext.Provider value={{ open, setOpen }}>
      {children}
    </DialogContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function DialogTrigger({
  asChild,
  children,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const context = React.useContext(DialogContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("DialogTrigger must be used inside Dialog");

  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    onClick?.(e);
    context.setOpen(true);
  };

  if (asChild && React.isValidElement(children)) {
    const child = children as React.ReactElement<{
      onClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
    }>;
    return React.cloneElement(child, {
      ...props,
      onClick: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        child.props?.onClick?.(e);
        context.setOpen(true);
      },
    });
  }

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleClick}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export function DialogClose({
  asChild,
  children,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const context = React.useContext(DialogContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("DialogClose must be used inside Dialog");

  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    onClick?.(e);
    context.setOpen(false);
  };

  if (asChild && React.isValidElement(children)) {
    const child = children as React.ReactElement<{
      onClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
    }>;
    return React.cloneElement(child, {
      ...props,
      onClick: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        child.props?.onClick?.(e);
        context.setOpen(false);
      },
    });
  }

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleClick}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export function DialogContent({
  className,
  children,
}: {
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const context = React.useContext(DialogContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("DialogContent must be used inside Dialog");

  const [mounted, setMounted] = React.useState(false);
  const [rendered, setRendered] = React.useState(context.open);
  const [isClosing, setIsClosing] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (context.open) {
      setRendered(true);
      setIsClosing(false);
    } else if (rendered) {
      setIsClosing(true);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setRendered(false);
        setIsClosing(false);
      }, 160);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [context.open, rendered]);

  const handleClose = React.useCallback(() => {
    context.setOpen(false);
  }, [context]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") handleClose();
    };
    if (rendered) {
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
      window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [rendered, handleClose]);

  if (!rendered || !mounted) return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[10000] flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div
        id="exposeMask"
        className={cn(
          "fixed inset-0 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-[2px]",
          isClosing ? "anim-lzt-backdrop-out" : "anim-lzt-backdrop-in"
        )}
        onClick={handleClose}
      />

      <div
        className={cn(
          "xenOverlay formOverlay relative z-50 w-full max-w-lg rounded-[12px] border border-[rgb(30,39,37)] bg-[rgb(17,22,21)] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-[rgb(214,214,214)] [&>*:not(.heading):not(.submitUnit):not(.close):not(.formOverlayContent)]:px-5 [&>*:not(.heading):not(.submitUnit):not(.close):not(.formOverlayContent)]:py-4",
          isClosing ? "anim-lzt-modal-out" : "anim-lzt-modal-in",
          className
        )}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleClose}
          aria-label="Закрыть"
          className="close OverlayCloser absolute right-3.5 top-3.5 z-20 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-white/[0.09] shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(233,233,233,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(233,233,233,0.5)] backdrop-blur-[2px] text-[#e9e9e9] opacity-80 hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[rgb(214,214,214)]" />
        </button>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

export function DialogHeader({
  variant = "default",
  className,
  children,
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & {
  variant?: "default" | "error" | "warning" | "security";
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "heading",
        variant === "default" && "bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] px-5 py-4 border-b border-[rgb(30,39,37)]",
        (variant === "warning" || variant === "security") &&
          "bg-[linear-gradient(140deg,rgb(184,115,18)_0%,rgb(110,68,11)_100%)] px-5 py-4 border-b border-[rgba(184,115,18,0.3)] text-[rgb(245,245,245)]",
        variant === "error" &&
          "bg-[linear-gradient(140deg,rgb(142,34,34)_0%,rgb(85,20,20)_100%)] px-5 py-4 border-b border-[rgba(142,34,34,0.3)] text-[rgb(245,245,245)]",
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function DialogTitle({
  className,
  children,
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>) {
  return (
    <h3
      className={cn(
        "text-[15px] font-medium text-[rgb(245,245,245)] leading-snug",
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </h3>
  );
}

export function DialogDescription({
  className,
  children,
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>) {
  return (
    <p
      className={cn("text-xs text-[rgb(140,162,154)] mt-1", className)}
    >
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}

export function DialogFooter({
  className,
  children,
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & {
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "ctrlUnit submitUnit flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 p-4 border-t border-[rgb(30,39,37)] bg-[rgb(24,30,28)]/40",
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function DialogBody({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn("formOverlayContent p-5 space-y-4 text-[14px]", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### badge.tsx

```typescript

  moderator: {
    background: "rgb(18, 71, 13)",
    color: "rgb(245, 245, 245)",
  },
  developer: {
    background: "rgb(191, 110, 4)",
    color: "rgb(245, 245, 245)",
  },
  curator: {
    background: "rgba(0, 255, 196, 0.43)",
    color: "rgb(245, 245, 245)",
  },
  sponsor: {
    background: "rgb(229, 217, 163)",
    color: "rgb(56, 56, 56)",
  },
};

const TAG_STYLES: Partial<Record<UserGroupKey, { color: string; border?: string }>> = {
  novoreg: { color: "rgb(148, 148, 148)" },
  local: { color: "rgb(148, 148, 148)" },
  resident: { color: "rgb(214, 214, 214)" },
  expert: { color: "rgb(179, 94, 222)", border: "rgba(179, 94, 222, 0.3)" },
  guru: { color: "rgb(255, 168, 175)", border: "rgba(255, 168, 175, 0.3)" },
  ai: { color: "rgb(255, 0, 118)", border: "rgba(255, 0, 118, 0.3)" },
  greatest: { color: "#b7ec5c", border: "rgba(183, 236, 92, 0.4)" },
  uniq: { color: "#0fdc91", border: "rgba(15, 220, 145, 0.4)" },
  unik: { color: "#0fdc91", border: "rgba(15, 220, 145, 0.4)" },
  legend: { color: "#0095dd", border: "rgba(0, 149, 221, 0.4)" },
  supreme: { color: "rgb(255, 66, 247)", border: "rgba(255, 66, 247, 0.4)" },
  sponsor: { color: "rgb(229, 217, 163)", border: "rgba(229, 217, 163, 0.4)" },
  admin: { color: "rgb(241, 56, 56)", border: "rgba(241, 56, 56, 0.4)" },
  chief_designer: { color: "rgb(230, 156, 217)", border: "rgba(92, 69, 255, 0.4)" },
  headDesigner: { color: "rgb(230, 156, 217)", border: "rgba(92, 69, 255, 0.4)" },
  designer: { color: "rgb(0, 117, 173)", border: "rgba(0, 117, 173, 0.4)" },
  chief_arbitr: { color: "rgb(255, 66, 247)", border: "rgba(255, 66, 247, 0.4)" },
  headArbitrator: { color: "rgb(255, 66, 247)", border: "rgba(255, 66, 247, 0.4)" },
  arbitr: { color: "rgb(255, 154, 252)", border: "rgba(255, 154, 252, 0.4)" },
  arbitrator: { color: "rgb(255, 154, 252)", border: "rgba(255, 154, 252, 0.4)" },
  chief_moder: { color: "rgb(46, 162, 74)", border: "rgba(46, 162, 74, 0.4)" },
  headModerator: { color: "rgb(46, 162, 74)", border: "rgba(46, 162, 74, 0.4)" },
  moder: { color: "rgb(18, 71, 13)", border: "rgba(18, 71, 13, 0.4)" },
  moderator: { color: "rgb(18, 71, 13)", border: "rgba(18, 71, 13, 0.4)" },
  developer: { color: "rgb(191, 110, 4)", border: "rgba(191, 110, 4, 0.4)" },
  curator: { color: "rgb(0, 255, 196)", border: "rgba(0, 255, 196, 0.4)" },
  editor: { color: "rgb(0, 135, 255)", border: "rgba(0, 135, 255, 0.4)" },
  banned: { color: "rgb(140, 162, 154)" },
};

export interface BadgeProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  group?: UserGroupKey;
  variant?: "banner" | "tag" | "pill";
  active?: boolean;
  onRemove?: () => void;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function Badge({
  group = "resident",
  variant = "tag",
  active = false,
  onRemove,
  icon,
  className,
  style,
  children,
  ...props
}: BadgeProps) {
  // 1. User Banner (.banner)
  if (variant === "banner") {
    const bannerStyle = BANNER_STYLES[group] || {
      background: "rgb(30, 39, 37)",
      color: "rgb(214, 214, 214)",
    };

    return (
      <div
        style={{
          background: bannerStyle.background,
          color: bannerStyle.color,
          boxShadow: bannerStyle.boxShadow,
          borderRadius: bannerStyle.borderRadius,
          textShadow: bannerStyle.textShadow,
          ...style,
        }}
        className={cn(
          "userBanner inline-flex items-center justify-center px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold select-none border-0 shadow-sm leading-tight",
          bannerStyle.borderRadius ? "" : "rounded-[5px]",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span>{children}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 2. Market Filter Pill (.pill)
  if (variant === "pill") {
    return (
      <div
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[28px] rounded-[1000px] px-3 text-xs font-medium transition-all select-none border",
          active
            ? "bg-[#00ba78]/15 border-[#00ba78]/40 text-[#00ba78]"
            : "bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:text-white border-transparent",
          onRemove && "pr-2",
          className
        )}
        style={style}
        {...props}
      >
        {icon && <span className="shrink-0">{icon}</span>}
        <span className="truncate">{children}</span>
        {onRemove && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onRemove();
            }}
            className="ml-0.5 rounded-full p-0.5 text-[rgb(140,162,154)] hover:text-white hover:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] transition"
          >
            <X className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[2.2]" />
            <span className="sr-only">Удалить</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 4. Default User Group Tag (.tag)
  const tagStyle = TAG_STYLES[group] || { color: "rgb(214, 214, 214)" };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        color: tagStyle.color,
        borderColor: tagStyle.border || "rgb(36, 47, 43)",
        ...style,
      }}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-[6px] px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold select-none border bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] transition-colors",
        group === "banned" && "line-through",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <span>{children}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### button.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { MoreHorizontal, Copy, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "button inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-semibold transition-all duration-150 focus-visible:outline-none disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 select-none cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.98]",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        primary:
          "primary bg-[linear-gradient(88deg,rgb(32,118,78)_0%,rgb(42,143,92)_50%,rgb(32,118,78)_100%)] hover:bg-[linear-gradient(88deg,rgb(38,136,90)_0%,rgb(48,162,105)_50%,rgb(38,136,90)_100%)] text-[rgb(245,245,245)] border-0 font-semibold rounded-[6px] outline -outline-offset-1 outline-[color-mix(in_srgb,rgb(245,245,245)_16%,transparent_84%)] shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.12)]",
        default:
          "bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:text-white border border-[rgb(36,47,43)] font-semibold rounded-[6px]",
        secondary:
          "secondary bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] hover:bg-[rgb(44,58,53)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:text-white border-0 font-semibold rounded-[6px] outline -outline-offset-1 outline-[color-mix(in_srgb,rgb(140,162,154)_40%,transparent_60%)]",
        danger:
          "danger bg-[rgba(241,56,56,0.12)] hover:bg-[rgba(241,56,56,0.2)] text-[rgb(241,56,56)] border border-[rgba(241,56,56,0.3)] rounded-[6px] font-semibold",
        ghost:
          "text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:text-white rounded-[6px] font-medium",
        more:
          "dottesStyle buttonStyle bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:text-white border-0 rounded-[6px] p-0 w-[34px] h-[34px] outline -outline-offset-1 outline-[rgb(36,47,43)]",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-[34px] px-[14px] text-[13px]",
        sm: "h-[28px] px-2.5 text-xs rounded-[5px]",
        lg: "h-[38px] px-[16px] text-sm rounded-[6px]",
        icon: "h-[34px] w-[34px] rounded-[6px] p-0",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "primary",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
);

export interface ButtonProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
  asChild?: boolean;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  ({ className, variant, size, isLoading = false, asChild = false, children, disabled, ...props }, ref) => {
    if (asChild && React.isValidElement(children)) {
      const child = children as React.ReactElement<{
        className?: string;
        ref?: React.Ref<any>;
      }>;
      return React.cloneElement(child, {
        ...props,
        ref,
        className: cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size }), child.props?.className, className),
      });
    }

    return (
      <button
        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
        ref={ref}
        disabled={disabled || isLoading}
        {...props}
      >
        {isLoading && (
          <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-white/25 border-t-white animate-spin shrink-0" />
        )}
        {variant === "more" && !children ? (
          <MoreHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-[rgb(140,162,154)]" />
        ) : (
          children
        )}
      </button>
    );
  }
);
Button.displayName = "Button";

/**
 * Кнопка копирования с индикатором успешного копирования
 */
export function CopyButton({
  text,
  className,
  onCopy,
}: {
  text: string;
  className?: string;
  onCopy?: () => void;
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);

  const handleCopy = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    onCopy?.();
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleCopy}
      title={copied ? "Скопировано" : "Скопировать"}
      className={cn(
        "copyButton copyButton--withCheck relative inline-flex items-center justify-center p-1 text-[rgb(140,162,154)] hover:text-[rgb(214,214,214)] cursor-pointer select-none transition-colors",
        copied && "copyButton--copied",
        className
      )}
    >
      <Copy className={cn("w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-opacity duration-200", copied && "opacity-0")} />
      <Check
        className={cn(
          "w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute inset-0 m-auto text-[#00ba78] transition-opacity duration-200 opacity-0 pointer-events-none",
          copied && "opacity-100"
        )}
      />
    </button>
  );
}

export { Button, buttonVariants };
```

### toast.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Types & Context
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

export type TimedMessageVariant = "success" | "error";

export interface TimedMessageItem {
  id: string;
  message: string;
  variant?: TimedMessageVariant;
  duration?: number;
  isExiting?: boolean;
}

export interface StackAlertItem {
  id: string;
  message: string;
  duration?: number;
  isExiting?: boolean;
}

interface ToastContextType {
  timedMessage: (
    message: string,
    options?: { variant?: TimedMessageVariant; duration?: number }
  ) => void;
  stackAlert: (message: string, options?: { duration?: number }) => void;
  toast: (
    message: string,
    options?: { variant?: TimedMessageVariant; duration?: number }
  ) => void;
}

const ToastContext = React.createContext<ToastContextType | undefined>(undefined);

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * ToastProvider: Mounts .xenOverlay.timedMessage & #StackAlerts
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [timedItem, setTimedItem] = React.useState<TimedMessageItem | null>(null);
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = React.useState<StackAlertItem[]>([]);
  const timedTimeoutRef = React.useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const exitTimeoutRef = React.useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const dismissTimed = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (timedTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timedTimeoutRef.current);
    if (exitTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(exitTimeoutRef.current);

    setTimedItem((cur) => (cur ? { ...cur, isExiting: true } : null));

    exitTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setTimedItem(null);
    }, 180);
  }, []);

  const showTimedMessage = React.useCallback(
    (
      message: string,
      options?: { variant?: TimedMessageVariant; duration?: number }
    ) => {
      const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
      const duration = options?.duration ?? 3000;
      const variant = options?.variant ?? "success";

      if (timedTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timedTimeoutRef.current);
      if (exitTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(exitTimeoutRef.current);

      setTimedItem({ id, message, variant, duration, isExiting: false });

      if (duration > 0) {
        timedTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setTimedItem((cur) => (cur?.id === id ? { ...cur, isExiting: true } : cur));

          exitTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
            setTimedItem((cur) => (cur?.id === id ? null : cur));
          }, 180);
        }, duration);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const dismissStackAlert = React.useCallback((id: string) => {
    setAlerts((prev) =>
      prev.map((a) => (a.id === id ? { ...a, isExiting: true } : a))
    );

    setTimeout(() => {
      setAlerts((prev) => prev.filter((a) => a.id !== id));
    }, 160);
  }, []);

  const showStackAlert = React.useCallback(
    (message: string, options?: { duration?: number }) => {
      const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
      const duration = options?.duration ?? 3500;

      setAlerts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, duration, isExiting: false }]);

      if (duration > 0) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          dismissStackAlert(id);
        }, duration);
      }
    },
    [dismissStackAlert]
  );

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider
      value={{
        timedMessage: showTimedMessage,
        stackAlert: showStackAlert,
        toast: showTimedMessage,
      }}
    >
      {children}

      {timedItem && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className={cn(
            "xenOverlay timedMessage fixed top-[52px] left-0 w-full z-[15000] flex justify-center pointer-events-none select-none",
            timedItem.isExiting ? "anim-timed-out" : "anim-timed-in"
          )}
        >
          <div
            onClick={dismissTimed}
            className="content pointer-events-auto bg-[#111615] border border-[#1e2725] rounded-[50px] shadow-[0_5px_26px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.32)] font-semibold text-[13px] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] px-[15px] py-[10px] w-fit flex items-center cursor-pointer hover:bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] transition-colors"
          >
            {timedItem.variant === "error" ? (
              <span className="timedMessage-icon timedMessage-icon--error w-[18px] h-[18px] mr-2 inline-flex shrink-0">
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                  <path
                    opacity="0.12"
                    d="M12 22C17.5228 22 22 17.5228 22 12C22 6.47715 17.5228 2 12 2C6.47715 2 2 6.47715 2 12C2 17.5228 6.47715 22 12 22Z"
                    fill="#FF4B4E"
                  />
                  <path
                    d="M15 9L9 15M9 9L15 15M22 12C22 17.5228 17.5228 22 12 22C6.47715 22 2 17.5228 2 12C2 6.47715 6.47715 2 12 2C17.5228 2 22 6.47715 22 12Z"
                    stroke="#FF4B4E"
                    strokeWidth="2"
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                  />
                </svg>
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="timedMessage-icon timedMessage-icon--success w-[18px] h-[18px] mr-2 inline-flex shrink-0">
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                  <path
                    opacity="0.12"
                    d="M12 22C17.5228 22 22 17.5228 22 12C22 6.47715 17.5228 2 12 2C6.47715 2 2 6.47715 2 12C2 17.5228 6.47715 22 12 22Z"
                    fill="#00BA78"
                  />
                  <path
                    d="M7.5 12L10.5 15L16.5 9M22 12C22 17.5228 17.5228 22 12 22C6.47715 22 2 17.5228 2 12C2 6.47715 6.47715 2 12 2C17.5228 2 22 6.47715 22 12Z"
                    stroke="#00BA78"
                    strokeWidth="2"
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                  />
                </svg>
              </span>
            )}
            <span>{timedItem.message}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div
        id="StackAlerts"
        className="fixed bottom-[35px] left-[65px] z-[9999] max-h-[50%] overflow-y-auto pointer-events-none select-none [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden flex flex-col"
      >
        {alerts.map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item.id}
            onClick={() => dismissStackAlert(item.id)}
            role="status"
            className={cn(
              "stackAlert pointer-events-auto relative w-[250px] bg-[rgb(39,39,39)] p-[15px_20px] rounded-[8px] mt-[15px] text-[14px] leading-[1.3] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 hover:opacity-90 shadow-lg",
              item.isExiting ? "anim-stack-out" : "anim-stack-in"
            )}
          >
            <div className="stackAlertContent break-words">{item.message}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast() {
  const context = React.useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!context) {
    // Graceful fallback for SSR/prerender or standalone usage
    return {
      timedMessage: () => {},
      stackAlert: () => {},
      toast: () => {},
    };
  }
  return context;
}

export const useTimedMessage = useToast;
export const useStackAlert = useToast;
```

### checkbox.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface CheckboxProps
  extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "type" | "onChange"> {
  checked?: boolean;
  defaultChecked?: boolean;
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  label?: React.ReactNode;
  description?: string;
}

const Checkbox = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, CheckboxProps>(
  (
    {
      className,
      checked: controlledChecked,
      defaultChecked = false,
      onCheckedChange,
      label,
      description,
      disabled,
      id,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const [uncontrolledChecked, setUncontrolledChecked] = React.useState(defaultChecked);
    const isControlled = controlledChecked !== undefined;
    const isChecked = isControlled ? controlledChecked : uncontrolledChecked;

    const generatedId = React.useId();
    const checkboxId = id || generatedId;

    const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (disabled) return;
      const next = e.target.checked;
      if (!isControlled) {
        setUncontrolledChecked(next);
      }
      onCheckedChange?.(next);
    };

    return (
      <label
        htmlFor={checkboxId}
        className={cn(
          "group inline-flex items-center gap-2 select-none cursor-pointer",
          disabled && "cursor-not-allowed opacity-40 pointer-events-none",
          className
        )}
      >
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          id={checkboxId}
          ref={ref}
          checked={isChecked}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={handleChange}
          className="sr-only"
          {...props}
        />
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            "relative flex h-[16px] w-[16px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[4px] border-2 transition-colors duration-150 pointer-events-none",
            isChecked
              ? "bg-[#00ba78] border-[#00ba78] text-white"
              : "bg-transparent border-[rgb(74,84,80)] group-hover:border-[rgb(140,162,154)]",
            disabled && "border-[rgb(45,55,51)]"
          )}
        >
          {isChecked && <Check className="h-3 w-3 stroke-[3]" />}
        </span>
        {(label || description) && (
          <div className="flex flex-col text-sm leading-none pointer-events-none">
            {label && (
              <span className="text-[14px] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
                {label}
              </span>
            )}
            {description && (
              <span className="text-xs text-[rgb(140,162,154)] mt-1">{description}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </label>
    );
  }
);
Checkbox.displayName = "Checkbox";

/**
 * Элемент чекбокса списка (.checkboxItem)
 */
export function CheckboxItem({
  checked,
  defaultChecked,
  onCheckedChange,
  disabled,
  children,
  className,
}: {
  checked?: boolean;
  defaultChecked?: boolean;
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "checkboxItem text-[14px] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] mb-1 select-none",
        disabled && "disabled opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed",
        className
      )}
    >
      <Checkbox
        checked={checked}
        defaultChecked={defaultChecked}
        onCheckedChange={onCheckedChange}
        disabled={disabled}
        label={children}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Строка фильтра с чекбоксом (.checkboxRow)
 */
export function CheckboxRow({
  checked,
  defaultChecked,
  onCheckedChange,
  disabled,
  children,
  className,
}: {
  checked?: boolean;
  defaultChecked?: boolean;
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "checkboxRow my-1 rounded-[6px] bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] px-[10px] py-[6px] text-[14px] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] transition-colors hover:bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] select-none",
        disabled && "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed pointer-events-none",
        className
      )}
    >
      <Checkbox
        checked={checked}
        defaultChecked={defaultChecked}
        onCheckedChange={onCheckedChange}
        disabled={disabled}
        label={children}
        className="w-full"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Радио-кнопка (.RadioOption)
 */
export interface RadioProps
  extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "type" | "onChange"> {
  checked?: boolean;
  defaultChecked?: boolean;
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  label?: React.ReactNode;
  description?: string;
}

export const Radio = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, RadioProps>(
  (
    {
      className,
      checked: controlledChecked,
      defaultChecked = false,
      onCheckedChange,
      label,
      description,
      disabled,
      id,
      name,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const [uncontrolledChecked, setUncontrolledChecked] = React.useState(defaultChecked);
    const isControlled = controlledChecked !== undefined;
    const isChecked = isControlled ? controlledChecked : uncontrolledChecked;

    const generatedId = React.useId();
    const radioId = id || generatedId;

    const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (disabled) return;
      const next = e.target.checked;
      if (!isControlled) {
        setUncontrolledChecked(next);
      }
      onCheckedChange?.(next);
    };

    return (
      <label
        htmlFor={radioId}
        className={cn(
          "RadioOption group inline-flex items-center gap-2 select-none cursor-pointer",
          disabled && "cursor-not-allowed opacity-40 pointer-events-none",
          className
        )}
      >
        <input
          type="radio"
          id={radioId}
          name={name}
          ref={ref}
          checked={isChecked}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={handleChange}
          className="sr-only"
          {...props}
        />
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            "relative flex h-[16px] w-[16px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 transition-colors duration-150 pointer-events-none",
            isChecked
              ? "border-[#00ba78] bg-transparent"
              : "bg-transparent border-[rgb(74,84,80)] group-hover:border-[rgb(140,162,154)]",
            disabled && "border-[rgb(45,55,51)]"
          )}
        >
          {isChecked && (
            <span className="h-[6px] w-[6px] rounded-full bg-[#00ba78]" />
          )}
        </span>
        {(label || description) && (
          <div className="flex flex-col text-sm leading-none pointer-events-none">
            {label && (
              <span className="text-[14px] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
                {label}
              </span>
            )}
            {description && (
              <span className="text-xs text-[rgb(140,162,154)] mt-1">{description}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </label>
    );
  }
);
Radio.displayName = "Radio";

export { Checkbox };
```

### dropdown-menu.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { UniqText, type UniqPreset } from "./uniq-text";

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Context & Primitives for Generic XenForo .Menu
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

interface DropdownContextType {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
}

const DropdownContext = React.createContext<DropdownContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export interface DropdownMenuProps {
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function DropdownMenu({
  open: controlledOpen,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  children,
}: DropdownMenuProps) {
  const [uncontrolledOpen, setUncontrolledOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
  const isControlled = controlledOpen !== undefined;
  const open = isControlled ? controlledOpen : uncontrolledOpen;

  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (action: React.SetStateAction<boolean>) => {
      const next = typeof action === "function" ? action(open) : action;
      if (!isControlled) {
        setUncontrolledOpen(next);
      }
      onOpenChange?.(next);
    },
    [isControlled, open, onOpenChange]
  );

  return (
    <DropdownContext.Provider value={{ open, setOpen }}>
      <div className="relative inline-block text-left">{children}</div>
    </DropdownContext.Provider>
  );
}

export interface DropdownMenuTriggerProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

export function DropdownMenuTrigger({
  asChild,
  children,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: DropdownMenuTriggerProps) {
  const context = React.useContext(DropdownContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("DropdownMenuTrigger must be inside DropdownMenu");

  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    onClick?.(e);
    context.setOpen(!context.open);
  };

  if (asChild && React.isValidElement(children)) {
    const child = children as React.ReactElement<{
      onClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
    }>;
    return React.cloneElement(child, {
      ...props,
      onClick: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        child.props?.onClick?.(e);
        context.setOpen(!context.open);
      },
    });
  }

  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={handleClick} {...props}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Кнопка опций с тремя точками (.dottesStyle)
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

export interface DottesTriggerProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  active?: boolean;
}

export const DottesTrigger = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, DottesTriggerProps>(
  ({ className, active, ...props }, ref) => {
    const context = React.useContext(DropdownContext);
    const isOpen = active ?? context?.open ?? false;

    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        aria-label="Опции темы"
        onClick={(e) => {
          props.onClick?.(e);
          context?.setOpen(!context.open);
        }}
        className={cn(
          "dottesStyle buttonStyle group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center w-[36px] h-[34px] rounded-[10px] bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] outline -outline-offset-1 outline-[rgb(36,47,43)] transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer select-none shrink-0",
          isOpen && "bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] outline-[rgb(44,58,53)]",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-[3px]">
          <span
            className={cn(
              "w-[3.5px] h-[3.5px] rounded-full bg-[rgb(140,162,154)] transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:bg-[#eaeaea]",
              isOpen && "bg-white"
            )}
          />
          <span
            className={cn(
              "w-[3.5px] h-[3.5px] rounded-full bg-[rgb(140,162,154)] transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:bg-[#eaeaea]",
              isOpen && "bg-white"
            )}
          />
          <span
            className={cn(
              "w-[3.5px] h-[3.5px] rounded-full bg-[rgb(140,162,154)] transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:bg-[#eaeaea]",
              isOpen && "bg-white"
            )}
          />
        </span>
      </button>
    );
  }
);
DottesTrigger.displayName = "DottesTrigger";

export interface DropdownMenuContentProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  align?: "left" | "right";
  width?: string;
}

export function DropdownMenuContent({
  align = "right",
  width = "w-[220px]",
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: DropdownMenuContentProps) {
  const context = React.useContext(DropdownContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("DropdownMenuContent must be inside DropdownMenu");

  const menuRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!context.open) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") context.setOpen(false);
    };

    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.parentElement?.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        context.setOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [context]);

  if (!context.open) return null;

  return (
    <div
      ref={menuRef}
      className={cn(
        "Menu absolute top-[calc(100%+6px)] z-50 rounded-[12px] border border-[rgb(30,39,37)] bg-[rgb(17,22,21)] shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgb(15,20,20)] py-1.5 overflow-hidden anim-lzt-dropdown-in select-none text-left",
        align === "right" ? "right-0" : "left-0",
        width,
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function DropdownMenuHeader({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "menuHeader px-3.5 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[rgb(140,162,154)] uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-[rgb(30,39,37)] mb-1",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export interface DropdownMenuItemProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: "default" | "danger";
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

export function DropdownMenuItem({
  variant = "default",
  icon,
  className,
  children,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: DropdownMenuItemProps) {
  const context = React.useContext(DropdownContext);

  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    onClick?.(e);
    context?.setOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleClick}
      className={cn(
        "w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-medium transition-colors duration-100 cursor-pointer text-left border-0 bg-transparent group",
        variant === "default" &&
          "text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:text-white",
        variant === "danger" &&
          "text-[rgb(241,56,56)] hover:bg-[rgba(241,56,56,0.12)] hover:text-[rgb(255,80,80)]",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {icon && (
        <span
          className={cn(
            "w-4 h-4 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[rgb(140,162,154)] transition-colors duration-100",
            variant === "default" && "group-hover:text-[#00ba78]",
            variant === "danger" && "text-[rgb(241,56,56)] group-hover:text-[rgb(255,80,80)]"
          )}
        >
          {icon}
        </span>
      )}
      <span className="truncate flex-1">{children}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

export function DropdownMenuDivider({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn("h-[1px] bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] my-1", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Триггер профиля пользователя в шапке (.accountPopup)

export function AccountTrigger({

  className,
  onClick,
}: {
  username?: string;
  balance?: string | number;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  className?: string;
  onClick?: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"

        "navLink accountPopup inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 h-[40px] rounded-full bg-transparent hover:bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer text-left border-0 select-none",
        className
      )}

      <b className="accountUsername text-sm font-bold text-[#0fdc91] leading-none">

            }}
            className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover rounded-full"
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface AccountMenuUser {
  name: string;
  avatar?: string;
  statusText?: string;
  balance?: number | string;
  uniqPreset?: UniqPreset;
  secondaryAccount?: {
    name: string;
    avatar?: string;
    balance?: string;
    unreadCount?: number;
  };
}

export interface AccountMenuProps {
  user?: AccountMenuUser;
  onDeposit?: () => void;
  onPayout?: () => void;
  onTransfer?: () => void;
  onSettings?: () => void;
  onLogout?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_USER: AccountMenuUser = {
  name: "Пользователь",
  statusText: "",
  balance: 0,
};

export function AccountMenu({
  user = DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_USER,
  onDeposit,
  onPayout,
  onTransfer,
  onSettings,
  onLogout,
  onClose,
  className,
}: AccountMenuProps) {
  const [showBalance, setShowBalance] = React.useState(true);

  return (
    <div
      id="AccountMenu"
      className={cn(
        "Menu HeaderMenu mobile-switch-menu w-[310px] rounded-[12px] border border-[rgb(30,39,37)] bg-[rgb(17,22,21)] shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgb(15,20,20)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] select-none overflow-hidden text-left",
        className
      )}
    >
      <div className="menuBlock max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
        {/* 1. Profile Background Block */}
        <div className="profileBackground flex flex-col items-center px-5 pt-6 pb-4 relative">
          {onClose && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="absolute top-3 right-3 text-[rgb(140,162,154)] hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Закрыть"
            >
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M18 6L6 18M6 6L18 18"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                />
              </svg>
            </button>
          )}

          <div className="imageBlock flex flex-col items-center gap-3 w-full">
            <div className="avatarGroup relative">
              <span className="menuAvatar w-[72px] h-[72px] rounded-full bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] text-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center [mask-image:radial-gradient(circle_at_right_12px_bottom_12px,transparent_16px,#000_17px)] [-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle_at_right_12px_bottom_12px,transparent_16px,#000_17px)]">
                {user.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
              </span>
              {user.avatar && (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img
                  src={user.avatar}
                  alt=""
                  onError={(e) => {
                    (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.display = "none";
                  }}
                  className="menuAvatar absolute inset-0 w-[72px] h-[72px] rounded-full block object-cover [mask-image:radial-gradient(circle_at_right_12px_bottom_12px,transparent_16px,#000_17px)] [-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle_at_right_12px_bottom_12px,transparent_16px,#000_17px)]"
                />
              )}
              <a

                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2.5"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                >
                  <path d="M12 5V19M5 12H19" />
                </svg>
              </a>
            </div>

            <div className="aboutUser grid gap-1 text-center w-full">
              <div className="username text-base font-semibold leading-tight">
                {user.uniqPreset ? (
                  <UniqText preset={user.uniqPreset}>{user.name}</UniqText>

                )}
              </div>
              {user.statusText && (
                <div className="userBlurb text-xs text-[rgb(140,162,154)] break-words leading-relaxed px-2">
                  {user.statusText}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <a
            href="#"
            className="button mt-3.5 inline-flex items-center justify-center h-[34px] px-4 rounded-[10px] bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] hover:text-white text-xs font-medium transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Перейти в профиль
          </a>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Balance Block */}
        <div className="balanceBlock mx-3 p-4 rounded-[16px] bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] border border-[#242f2b] flex flex-col gap-3.5">
          <div className="amountBlock flex flex-col gap-1.5 w-full">
```
