```typescript
                className="text-[rgb(140,162,154)] hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer p-1"
                title="Показать / скрыть баланс"
              >
                <svg
                  width="18"
                  height="18"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                >
                  {showBalance ? (
                    <>
                      <path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z" />
                      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24" />
                      <line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23" />
                    </>
                  )}
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 3 Action Buttons: Пополнить, Вывести, Перевести */}
          <div className="actionsBlock flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
            <div className="buttonContainer flex flex-col gap-1.5 items-center w-full">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onDeposit}
                className="button secondary w-full h-[40px] rounded-[12px] bg-[rgb(55,211,141,0.12)] hover:bg-[rgb(55,211,141,0.18)] outline -outline-offset-1 outline-[color-mix(in_srgb,rgb(55,211,141)_40%,transparent)] flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer"
                title="Пополнить"
              >
                <div className="SvgIcon flex items-center justify-center text-[#37D38D]">
                  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                    <path
                      fillRule="evenodd"
                      clipRule="evenodd"
                      d="M12 1C5.92487 1 1 5.92487 1 12C1 18.0751 5.92487 23 12 23C18.0751 23 23 18.0751 23 12C23 5.92487 18.0751 1 12 1ZM12 7C12.5523 7 13 7.44772 13 8V11H16C16.5523 11 17 11.4477 17 12C17 12.5523 16.5523 13 16 13H13V16C13 16.5523 12.5523 17 12 17C11.4477 17 11 16.5523 11 16V13H8C7.44772 13 7 12.5523 7 12C7 11.4477 7.44772 11 8 11H11V8C11 7.44772 11.4477 7 12 7Z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                </div>
              </button>
              <span className="text-[12px] text-[rgb(214,214,214)]">Пополнить</span>
            </div>

            <div className="buttonContainer flex flex-col gap-1.5 items-center w-full">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onPayout}
                className="button w-full h-[40px] rounded-[12px] bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] hover:bg-[rgb(36,47,43)] outline -outline-offset-1 outline-[rgb(44,58,53)] flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer"
                title="Вывести"

                  d="M9.39504 19.3711L9.97949 20.6856C10.1532 21.0768 10.4368 21.4093 10.7957 21.6426C11.1547 21.8759 11.5736 22.0001 12.0017 22C12.4298 22.0001 12.8488 21.8759 13.2077 21.6426C13.5667 21.4093 13.8502 21.0768 14.0239 20.6856L14.6084 19.3711C14.8164 18.9047 15.1664 18.5159 15.6084 18.26C16.0532 18.0034 16.5677 17.8941 17.0784 17.9478L18.5084 18.1C18.934 18.145 19.3636 18.0656 19.7451 17.8713C20.1265 17.6771 20.4434 17.3763 20.6573 17.0056C20.8714 16.635 20.9735 16.2103 20.951 15.7829C20.9285 15.3555 20.7825 14.9438 20.5306 14.5978L19.6839 13.4344C19.3825 13.0171 19.2214 12.5148 19.2239 12C19.2238 11.4866 19.3864 10.9864 19.6884 10.5711L20.535 9.40778C20.7869 9.06175 20.933 8.65007 20.9554 8.22267C20.9779 7.79528 20.8759 7.37054 20.6617 7C20.4478 6.62923 20.1309 6.32849 19.7495 6.13423C19.3681 5.93997 18.9385 5.86053 18.5128 5.90556L17.0828 6.05778C16.5722 6.11141 16.0576 6.00212 15.6128 5.74556C15.1699 5.48825 14.8199 5.09736 14.6128 4.62889L14.0239 3.31444C13.8502 2.92317 13.5667 2.59072 13.2077 2.3574C12.8488 2.12408 12.4298 1.99993 12.0017 2C11.5736 1.99993 11.1547 2.12408 10.7957 2.3574C10.4368 2.59072 10.1532 2.92317 9.97949 3.31444L9.39504 4.62889C9.18797 5.09736 8.83792 5.48825 8.39504 5.74556C7.95026 6.00212 7.43571 6.11141 6.92504 6.05778L5.4906 5.90556C5.06493 5.86053 4.63534 5.93997 4.25391 6.13423C3.87249 6.32849 3.55561 6.62923 3.34171 7C3.12753 7.37054 3.02549 7.79528 3.04798 8.22267C3.07046 8.65007 3.2165 9.06175 3.46838 9.40778L4.31504 10.5711C4.61698 10.9864 4.77958 11.4866 4.77949 12C4.77958 12.5134 4.61698 13.0137 4.31504 13.4289L3.46838 14.5922C3.2165 14.9382 3.07046 15.3499 3.04798 15.7773C3.02549 16.2047 3.12753 16.6295 3.34171 17C3.55582 17.3706 3.87274 17.6712 4.25411 17.8654C4.63548 18.0596 5.06496 18.1392 5.4906 18.0944L6.9206 17.9422C7.43127 17.8886 7.94581 17.9979 8.3906 18.2544C8.83513 18.511 9.18681 18.902 9.39504 19.3711Z"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                />
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <span>Настройки</span>
          </a>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onLogout}
            className="footerItem red w-[40px] h-[40px] rounded-[10px] bg-[rgb(255,86,86,0.14)] hover:bg-[rgb(255,86,86,0.22)] outline -outline-offset-1 outline-[color-mix(in_srgb,rgb(229,136,136,0.28)_40%,transparent)] flex items-center justify-center text-[#ff5656] transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            title="Выйти из аккаунта"
          >
            <div className="SvgIcon flex items-center justify-center">
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M16 17.0001L21 12.0001M21 12.0001L16 7.00006M21 12.0001H9M12 17.0001C12 17.2956 12 17.4434 11.989 17.5715C11.8748 18.902 10.8949 19.9969 9.58503 20.2573C9.45903 20.2824 9.31202 20.2987 9.01835 20.3314L7.99694 20.4448C6.46248 20.6153 5.69521 20.7006 5.08566 20.5055C4.27293 20.2455 3.60942 19.6516 3.26118 18.8725C3 18.2883 3 17.5163 3 15.9724V8.02776C3 6.48383 3 5.71186 3.26118 5.12758C3.60942 4.34854 4.27293 3.75467 5.08566 3.49459C5.69521 3.29953 6.46246 3.38478 7.99694 3.55528L9.01835 3.66877C9.31212 3.70141 9.45901 3.71773 9.58503 3.74279C10.8949 4.00322 11.8748 5.0981 11.989 6.42867C12 6.5567 12 6.70449 12 7.00006"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### select.tsx

```typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { ChevronDown, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface SelectOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  group?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

export interface SelectProps {
  options: SelectOption[];
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  searchable?: boolean;
  size?: "default" | "extraLarge";
  className?: string;
}

export function Select({
  options,
  value: controlledValue,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
  placeholder = "Выберите...",
  disabled = false,
  searchable,
  size = "default",
  className,
}: SelectProps) {
  const [uncontrolledValue, setUncontrolledValue] = React.useState<string | undefined>(
    defaultValue || (options.length > 0 ? options[0]?.value : undefined)
  );
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = React.useState("");
  const containerRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const searchInputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const isControlled = controlledValue !== undefined;
  const currentValue = isControlled ? controlledValue : uncontrolledValue;
  const selectedOption = options.find((opt) => opt.value === currentValue);

  const isSearchable = searchable !== undefined ? searchable : options.length > 7;

  const filteredOptions = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return options;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return options.filter(
      (opt) => opt.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || opt.group?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [options, searchQuery]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleOutsideClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
        setSearchQuery("");
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleOutsideClick);
      if (isSearchable) {
        setTimeout(() => searchInputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
      }
    }
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleOutsideClick);
  }, [isOpen, isSearchable]);

  const handleSelect = (val: string) => {
    if (!isControlled) {
      setUncontrolledValue(val);
    }
    onChange?.(val);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setSearchQuery("");
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={cn(
        "chosen-container chosen-container-single textCtrl relative inline-block w-full select-none rounded-[10px] bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] text-[14px] transition-all duration-150",
        size === "extraLarge" ? "extraLarge min-h-[38px]" : "min-h-[34px]",
        isOpen && "chosen-container-active chosen-with-drop shadow-[0_0_0_2px_rgb(46,97,74)]",
        disabled && "chosen-disabled cursor-not-allowed opacity-50",
        className
      )}
    >
      <a
        role="button"
        tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
        onClick={() => !disabled && setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!disabled) setIsOpen(!isOpen);
          } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
            setIsOpen(false);
          }
        }}
        className={cn(
          "chosen-single flex w-full items-center justify-between px-[12px] text-[14px] cursor-pointer outline-none",
          size === "extraLarge" ? "h-[38px] leading-[38px]" : "h-[34px] leading-[34px]"
        )}
      >
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
          {selectedOption?.icon}
          {selectedOption?.group && (
            <span className="group-name text-[rgb(140,162,154)] text-xs font-normal mr-1">
              {selectedOption.group}:
            </span>
          )}
          <span className={selectedOption ? "text-[rgb(214,214,214)]" : "text-[rgb(140,162,154)]"}>
            {selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : placeholder}
          </span>
        </span>
        <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center w-[20px] ml-1">
          <ChevronDown
            className={cn(
              "w-4 h-4 text-[rgb(140,162,154)] transition-transform duration-200",
              isOpen && "rotate-180 text-[rgb(214,214,214)]"
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </a>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="chosen-drop absolute left-0 top-[calc(100%+4px)] z-[5000] w-full rounded-[10px] border border-[rgb(30,39,37)] bg-[rgb(17,22,21)] shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in-0 duration-100">
          {isSearchable && (
            <div className="chosen-search p-2 border-b border-[rgb(30,39,37)] bg-[rgb(24,30,28)]">
              <input
                ref={searchInputRef}
                type="text"
                autoComplete="off"
                placeholder="Поиск..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Escape") {
                    setIsOpen(false);
                  }
                }}
                className="w-full h-[28px] rounded-[6px] bg-[rgb(17,22,21)] border border-[rgb(36,47,43)] px-2.5 text-xs text-[rgb(214,214,214)] placeholder:text-[rgb(90,105,99)] outline-none focus:border-[#00ba78]"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <ul className="chosen-results max-h-[260px] overflow-y-auto py-1 m-0 list-none [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
            {filteredOptions.length === 0 ? (
              <li className="no-results text-center py-3 text-xs text-[rgb(140,162,154)]">
                Не найдено вариантов
              </li>
            ) : (
              filteredOptions.map((option) => {
                const isSelected = option.value === currentValue;
                return (
                  <li
                    key={option.value}
                    onClick={() => handleSelect(option.value)}
                    className={cn(
                      "active-result flex items-center justify-between px-[15px] py-[6px] text-[14px] cursor-pointer text-[rgb(214,214,214)] transition-colors duration-150",
                      isSelected
                        ? "result-selected bg-[rgb(30,39,37)] text-[rgb(245,245,245)] font-medium"
                        : "hover:bg-[rgb(30,39,37)]"
                    )}
                  >
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                      {option.icon}
                      <span>{option.label}</span>
                    </span>
                    {isSelected && <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00ba78] shrink-0" />}
                  </li>
                );
              })
            )}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### input.tsx

```typescript
import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface InputProps extends React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> {
  inputSize?: "default" | "extraLarge";
}

const Input = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(
  ({ className, type, inputSize = "default", ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <input
        type={type}
        className={cn(
          "textCtrl w-full rounded-[6px] border border-[rgb(36,47,43)] bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] px-[12px] text-[13px] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] placeholder:text-[rgb(90,105,99)] outline-none transition-all duration-150 focus:border-[#228e5d] focus:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_#228e5d] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
          inputSize === "default" ? "h-[34px] leading-[34px]" : "extraLarge h-[38px] min-h-[38px] leading-[38px] px-[14px]",
          className
        )}
        ref={ref}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  }
);
Input.displayName = "Input";

export interface TextareaProps
  extends React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement> {
  elastic?: boolean;
}

const Textarea = React.forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, TextareaProps>(
  ({ className, elastic = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <textarea
        className={cn(
          "textCtrl w-full rounded-[6px] border border-[rgb(36,47,43)] bg-[rgb(24,30,28)] p-[10px] text-[13px] text-[rgb(214,214,214)] placeholder:text-[rgb(90,105,99)] outline-none transition-all duration-150 focus:border-[#228e5d] focus:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_#228e5d] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 min-h-[72px] resize-y leading-relaxed",
          elastic && "Elastic",
          className
        )}
        ref={ref}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  }
);
Textarea.displayName = "Textarea";

export function InputRelative({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("inputRelative relative inline-block w-full", className)} {...props}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function InputRelativeIcon({
  className,
  children,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>) {
  return (
    <span
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn(
        "inputRelativeIcon absolute right-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center text-[15px] text-[rgb(140,162,154)] hover:text-[rgb(214,214,214)] cursor-pointer select-none transition-colors",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

export { Input, Textarea };
```

### uniq-text.tsx

```typescript
import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type UniqPreset =
  | "scope"
  | "raysmorgan"
  | "extasy"
  | "uniq"
  | "unik"
  | "zelenka"
  | "greatest"
  | "gold"
  | "flame";

export interface UniqTextProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  preset?: UniqPreset;
  glow?: boolean;
  href?: string;
  target?: string;
  rel?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

const SCOPE_STYLE: React.CSSProperties = {
  color: "#ffa6f7",
  fontWeight: 700,
  textShadow:
    "0px -3px 3px #f900c9, 0px 2px 3px #18132c, 0px -2px 1px #ff02e4, 0px -3px 3px #18132c, 0px -3px 3px #2e00eb, 0px 1px 1px #350d71, 0px 0px 3px #2400b5, 0px 0px 3px #ff00ea, 0px 0px 3px #c400ff, 0px 2px #ff00f4",
};

const RAYSMORGAN_STYLE: React.CSSProperties = {
  color: "#f13838",
  fontWeight: 700,
};

const EXTASY_GRADIENT = "linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(92, 69, 255) 0%, rgb(254, 181, 242) 100%)";

const GOLD_STYLE: React.CSSProperties = {
  color: "#ffd700",
  fontWeight: 700,
  textShadow: "0 0 8px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.55), 0 0 2px #b8860b",
};

const GRADIENT_PRESETS: Record<string, { bg: string; glow?: string }> = {
  uniq: {
    bg: "linear-gradient(90deg, #007a98 0%, #0bad9a 50%, #0fdc91 100%)",
    glow: "drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(15, 220, 145, 0.45))",
  },
  unik: {
    bg: "linear-gradient(90deg, #007a98 0%, #0bad9a 50%, #0fdc91 100%)",
    glow: "drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(15, 220, 145, 0.45))",
  },
  zelenka: {
    bg: "linear-gradient(90deg, #228e5d 0%, #00ba78 50%, #37d38d 100%)",
    glow: "drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(0, 186, 120, 0.45))",
  },
  greatest: {
    bg: "linear-gradient(90deg, #b7ec5c 0%, #84c317 50%, #70a11d 100%)",
    glow: "drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(183, 236, 92, 0.45))",
  },
  flame: {
    bg: "linear-gradient(90deg, #ff4500 0%, #ff8c00 50%, #ffd700 100%)",
    glow: "drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.45))",
  },
};

export function UniqText({
  preset = "uniq",
  glow = false,
  href,
  target,
  rel,
  children,
  className,
  style,
  ...props
}: UniqTextProps) {
  const Comp = href ? "a" : "span";
  const linkProps = href
    ? {
        href,
        target: target ?? "_blank",
        rel: rel ?? "noopener noreferrer",
      }
    : {};

  if (preset === "scope") {
    return (
      <Comp
        {...linkProps}
        style={{ ...SCOPE_STYLE, ...style }}
        className={cn(
          "styleUserNickname inline-flex items-center select-none tracking-wide",
          href && "hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span>{children}</span>
      </Comp>
    );
  }

  if (preset === "raysmorgan") {
    return (
      <Comp
        {...linkProps}
        style={{ ...RAYSMORGAN_STYLE, ...style }}
        className={cn(
          "styleUserNickname style3 inline-flex items-center select-none tracking-wide",
          href && "hover:underline cursor-pointer",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span>{children}</span>
      </Comp>
    );
  }

  if (preset === "extasy") {
    return (
      <Comp
        {...linkProps}
        style={{
          backgroundImage: EXTASY_GRADIENT,
          WebkitBackgroundClip: "text",
          WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent",
          ...style,
        }}
        className={cn(
          "styleUserNickname style350 inline-flex items-center font-bold tracking-wide select-none",
          href && "hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span>{children}</span>
      </Comp>
    );
  }

  if (preset === "gold") {
    return (
      <Comp
        {...linkProps}
        style={{ ...GOLD_STYLE, ...style }}
        className={cn(
          "styleUserNickname inline-flex items-center select-none tracking-wide",
          href && "hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span>{children}</span>
      </Comp>
    );
  }

  const grad = GRADIENT_PRESETS[preset] || GRADIENT_PRESETS.uniq;

  return (
    <Comp
      {...linkProps}
      style={{
        backgroundImage: grad.bg,
        WebkitBackgroundClip: "text",
        WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent",
        filter: glow && grad.glow ? grad.glow : undefined,
        ...style,
      }}
      className={cn(
        "styleUserNickname inline-flex items-center font-bold tracking-wide select-none",
        href && "hover:underline cursor-pointer",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <span>{children}</span>
    </Comp>
  );
}

export const UnikText = UniqText;
```
